The workbook generation failed due to invalid Excel formulas in the statistics section, resulting in #NAME? errors.
The test_derived_values_and_stats failed with an AssertionError in test_outputs.py. Specifically, cells H46 through L47 returned #NAME? instead of the expected float values (e.g., H46 expected -1.518795, got #NAME?). This indicates that the formulas written to the 'Task' worksheet use undefined names, unsupported functions, or incorrect syntax that openpyxl or the verifier cannot resolve.
